info.name: Composio Platform Account Management Auth Configs API
List authentication configurations with optional filters

params.name: is_composio_managed
params.description: Whether to filter by composio managed auth configs

params.name: toolkit_slug
params.description: Comma-separated list of toolkit slugs to filter auth configs by

params.name: deprecated_app_id
params.description: The app id to filter by

params.name: search
params.description: Search auth configs by name or id

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of items per page, max allowed is 1000

params.name: cursor
params.description: Cursor for pagination. The cursor is a base64 encoded string of the page and limit. The page is the page number and the limit is the number of items per page. The cursor is used to paginate through the items. The cursor is not required for the first page.

items.docs: Retrieves all auth configs for your project. Auth configs define how users authenticate with external services (OAuth, API keys, etc.). Use filters to find configs for specific toolkits or to distinguish between Composio-managed and custom configurations.

Creates a new auth config for a toolkit, allowing you to use your own OAuth credentials or API keys instead of Composio-managed authentication. This is required when you want to use custom OAuth apps (bring your own client ID/secret) or configure specific authentication parameters for a toolkit.

info.name: Get single authentication configuration by ID

params.name: nanoid
params.description: The unique identifier of the authentication configuration to retrieve

items.docs: Retrieves detailed information about a specific authentication configuration using its unique identifier.

params.name: nanoid
params.description: The unique identifier of the authentication configuration to update

items.docs: Modifies an existing authentication configuration with new credentials or other settings. Only specified fields will be updated.

params.name: nanoid
params.description: The unique identifier of the authentication configuration to delete

items.docs: Soft-deletes an authentication configuration by marking it as deleted in the database. This operation cannot be undone.

info.name: Enable or disable an authentication configuration

params.name: nanoid
params.description: The unique identifier of the authentication configuration to update

params.name: status
params.description: The new status to set for the auth configuration

items.docs: Updates the status of an authentication configuration to either enabled or disabled. Disabled configurations cannot be used for new connections.
Returns a list of authentication configurations for toolkit access.
Creates a new authentication configuration containing developer credentials and app-level settings.
